chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
If I were invited to a trotter, I would accept, and if a trotter were gifted to me, I would accept it.

key_terms.دُعِيتُ: I was invited; being asked to attend or partake
key_terms.كُرَاعٍ: a trotter; a very modest portion of food
key_terms.لَأَجَبْتُ: I would surely respond; I would accept the invitation

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about accepting simple gifts and invitations?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of humility, graciousness, and accepting simple hospitality or modest gifts without disdain. It reflects the noble character and sunnah of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله in honoring social bonds through generosity and acceptance.
